summary: SNDK up 13% today (May 5) hitting new 52-week high; +17.6% past week; +72.59% past month; +361.92% YTD. Q3 FY2026 earnings: revenue $5.95B (+251% YoY), beat by 25.68%; datacenter revenue +645% YoY to $1.467B; gross margin 78.4% (vs 22.5% prior year). Five long-term supply contracts signed covering 1/3 of BiCS flash production. US launches Pax Silica coalition to stabilize memory chip supply vs China. Price targets raised to $1,500-$2,000 by Fox Advisors, Bernstein, Susquehanna.
